title: Convicted of Theft, an Ex-Prime Minister Is Set to Swap Prison for Mansion
summary_full: The former prime minister of Malaysia, Najib Razak, was convicted in the multibillion-dollar 1MDB scandal. He’ll serve out his time at a luxury home.
